notes.note: Speaker labels in this slice (all 'Zero') are wrong for the leader blocks. 0711.bla shows row n+1 for MessWinSet(n) and picks each block row with an if-chain on the leader id; order for #0.243-257 and #0.261-275: 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Nu, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Rider 1, Black RX, Zeta, God, Mebius, Zero, Den-O (Momotaros). Voice checks out (#0.257/#0.275 Momotaros-rough, #0.273 Mebius 'boku').

For #0.243-257 the script names the speaker 'W (Philip)' when W leads (CharaNameIn 198), so this calm 'What did you say...?' is Philip's. In #0.261-275 W's line (#0.264) uses W's own name (Shotaro voice).
Narration (CharaNameOut). 'his' from glossary g=m for Dinosaur Greeed.

#0.266-268 = Ultraman, Seven, Taro ('wareware'). Identical Japanese kept identical. 'Our own negative memories' covers the bare 'we ... negative memories' fragment; the collecting is implied by Greeed's #0.242/#0.258.
Momotaros: 'tekitou na koto iyagatte' rendered at full roughness ('Quit makin' crap up').

Never displayed: 0711.bla jumps from MessWinSet(276) (#0.277) to MessWinSet(278) (#0.279), so Ankh's #0.277 runs straight into #0.279. Translated anyway as an unknown party member's question. #0.279 opens with '...then' so it completes #0.277 as played; it still reads as an answer if #0.278 were restored.

#0.280-0.330 are never shown by 0711.bla (script ends at #0.279); no Pt_Chara_Check order applies. Leader blocks #0.280-294, #0.297-311, #0.316-330 voiced from wording only. #0.294 Momotaros-style ('omee'). Identical Japanese gets identical English (also #0.287, which differs only by a line break).
Speaker inferred: Seravee's Voice (Veda-monitoring report, matches #0.206). 'Shouakuritsu' = Veda's control rate over the cube; 'territory' follows 0706 #0.56.
Speaker inferred: Ankh, snapping back at the 'Wait!' block. Rough 'dou shiro tte n da' kept at strength ('what the hell').
#0.313-315 inferred as Seravee's Voice: 'boku' + 'support you through Veda'; next block thanks 'Ankh and Seravee'. Uncertain whether #0.313 might be Ankh.
Long row (two full source lines); tightened to fit, full meaning kept.

report: 80/80 rows.
